sources.quote: BM25 scores documents via term-frequency saturation and document-length normalization
Contriever trains bi-encoder dense passage representations via contrastive learning
RRFscore(d) = sum 1 / (k + r(d)) with k = 60 fixed across retrieval rankings
A BERT cross-encoder scores query-passage pairs jointly for top-k neural reranking

methods.exact_change: Sequential composition of BM25, Contriever, RRF (k=60), and monoBERT reranking with no new architecture claimed
methods.simplest_alternative: BM25-only (or Contriever-only) single-stage retrieval and uncalibrated min-max linear score fusion (0.449 NDCG@10)
methods.ablation_evidence: Single-retriever baselines and min-max linear fusion (0.449) vs rank-only RRF (0.482) on BEIR-OOD-Subset-v1

parsimony_audit.ablation_evidence: Evaluated RRF (0.482) vs linear score fusion (0.449) on fixed candidate pools
